obligation_candidates.canon_label: Use `subject_id` only when the target is canonical renderable/openable content.
exact_tokens: Use `subject_id` only when the target is canonical renderable/openable content.
Use `object_kind` + `object_id` for all runtime, governance, conversational, and workflow objects.
Put the classification rule directly in `Contracts_V0.md`.
Keep `subject_id` frozen to the two canonical families until a new cross-surface content identity proves necessary.
`subject_id` is not a second generic object taxonomy. If `subject_id` expands carelessly, the whole routing model becomes muddy again.
notes: Hard classification rule: subject_id only for openable/renderable content subjects (doc: and artifact:). All other navigation goes through object_kind+object_id. Wizard and message flows already behave like object routes but some docs still make them look like special deep-link payload families — this must be corrected in those docs.
